reason: The price is nothing for my team, but I don't know who is behind this and no owner I know uses it. I'm not putting my customers' WhatsApp and my technicians' daily routine on an unknown app, least of all before the AC rush when I can't afford confusion.
objection: Who are these people? If they shut down next year, my AMC dates and job history are gone and I have to retrain my whole team again.
would_change_my_mind: A fellow service company owner or my distributor telling me they have used it for a few months and their technicians actually press the button.
